superseded_fields.E1_runs.jsonl:deadlock_type: contact-cluster grouping, superseded by the keystone classes (data/derived/E1_keystone.json; plan change C12)

doc:
E1 analysis, each mode separately. Input data/E1/E1_runs.jsonl(.gz); output data/derived/E1_analysis.json.

Definitions follow wave2/scripts/w21_analyze.py:
  stuck-alone agent   margin_C1 = g_max(r) - m v0 / tau > 0 (rest state on the door axis, rho = 0);
  blocker             residual agent nearest the door centre (10, 5) in a run that did not complete;
  end-of-queue rule   a stuck-alone agent is predicted to exit iff at least k other agents are active
                      when it first reaches the door zone (others = n_active at arrival - 1); only
                      stuck-alone agents that reached the door zone enter the rule.
Leave-one-seed-out: for each seed, k in 1..29 is chosen to maximise pooled agent-level accuracy on the
other seeds (ties: smallest k) and applied to that seed's stuck-alone agents. Confidence intervals
from 2000 resamples of seeds (with replacement; percentile intervals; numpy PCG64 seed 12345).
ROC AUC: score = others active at arrival, positive class = exited (Mann-Whitney, ties count 1/2).
The AUC is the headline number (plan change C13).
Refinement (C13), at the rule's k = 3:
  all-exit baseline   accuracy of predicting that every stuck-alone agent exits (= fraction that exit);
  error split         rule errors among non-exited agents split into final blockers (the run's blocker)
                      and agents queued behind a blocker (not exited, not the blocker); errors among
                      exited agents (predicted stuck, observed exit) reported separately;
  restricted accuracy accuracy over final blockers plus exited agents (queued agents left out).
The contact-cluster deadlock type (field deadlock_type in E1_runs.jsonl) is superseded by the keystone
classes (experiments/E1/keystone.py, data/derived/E1_keystone.json) and is no longer summarised here.
setup: C1, room bottleneck w=0.8 m, 100 agents, dt=0.01 s, sigma=0, cap 600 s, stop at deadlock (all active |v|<0.01 m/s for 10 s, no exit) or completion, w2_metrics=light; seeds 42-241

stuck_alone_boundary.note: C1: stuck alone iff v0/tau < g_max(r)/m. C3 rest state: iff m v0 (1/tau + w_o/tau_ORCA) < g_max(r); in the (r, v0/tau) plane this depends on tau, given for tau = 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 s.
